Copy button

A small button that copies a value shown next to it, and says in words that it did.

Status: draft

Examples

When to use it

  • Beside a value the view already shows as text, where the reader may want it on the clipboard: a branch name in a row, a commit hash in a key-value list, a command in a table cell.
  • Above a block of code or a log, to copy the whole block.
  • With only an icon where several values in a dense list each have one.

When not to use it

  • When taking the value away is the point of the view, such as a clone URL or a token shown once. Use the copy field, which puts the value in a box that can be selected and scrolled.
  • For a value the view does not show. The reader must be able to see what will be copied.
  • For a secret. Do not put one on the clipboard from a button in a list.
  • For any action other than copying. Use a button.

Variants

with a label
The default: ds-button ds-button--quiet ds-button--small with the copy icon and the word Copy.
icon only
ds-button ds-button--quiet ds-icon-button with the copy icon and an aria-label, for a dense row or a table cell. It is 44px square.

Sizes

default
The labelled button is drawn 32px tall with a 44px pointer target. The icon-only button is 44px square.

Accessibility

  • Wrap the button and its status in a span with the class ds-copy-button. The button is a ds-button with type="button"; this component adds no class to it.
  • Give the button an aria-label that starts with Copy and names the value, such as Copy branch name, so several on one view can be told apart. The icon carries aria-hidden="true".
  • Keep an empty span with ds-copy-button__status and role="status" next to the button from the start, after it or, at the trailing end of a row, before it. role="status" is a polite live region.
  • The app copies with navigator.clipboard.writeText() on a press, then sets the status text to Copied, or to what was copied, such as Branch name copied. A screen reader announces it and sighted readers see the same word. Clear the text after about 2 seconds.
  • The confirmation is that word. Do not signal a copy by changing the button's colour or icon alone, do not change the button's name, and do not move focus away from the button.
  • If the copy fails, set the status text to say so and what to do: Not copied. Select the text and copy it by hand.
  • Set the disabled attribute while there is nothing to copy yet.
  • Tab reaches the button, and Enter and Space press it. Both come from the button element.
